user.title: Set up HA SSL
user.description:
Pick a DNS provider and confirm the domain — everything else is automatic: issue the certificate, write it into Home Assistant's HTTPS config, restart to activate, and renew before expiry.

**Domain**: defaults to Home Assistant's own URL, usually no change needed.
**Credentials**: stored locally only, asked in the next step. Prefer a sub-account or token with DNS-only permissions.

ACME directory: {production} (staging: {staging})

data.staging: Use the Let's Encrypt staging environment

data_description.domain: Leave empty to use the host name from Home Assistant's own URL
data_description.cert_dir: Defaults to /config/ssl. Note it is not /ssl — that is the add-on mount path
data_description.staging: Debugging only: staging certificates are not trusted by browsers or the app

credentials.title: Enter {provider} credentials
credentials.description:
{provider_help}

On save the credentials are used to query {provider} and verify the domain before issuing.

data_description.aliyun_access_key_secret: Shown only once at creation — copy it immediately
data_description.dnspod_token: Secret string shown when the token is created

ddns.title: Dynamic DNS (optional)
ddns.description:
Turn this on if the domain should always follow your home's public IP. The integration checks the egress address every few minutes and updates the records for {domain} when it moves.

Leave it off to skip; you can enable it later from Configure.

data_description.ddns_record: Usually the certificate domain itself, or a subdomain such as home.example.com
data_description.ddns_record_types: A (IPv4) is the usual choice; AAAA only when the line has a fixed IPv6
data_description.ddns_interval: How often to look up the public IP, default 5 minutes
data_description.ddns_ttl: TTL written into the record, default 600 seconds
data_description.ddns_notify: Send a persistent notification when the IP changes or a record write fails

error.invalid_auth: Invalid credentials, or this account does not own the domain. Common causes: disabled AccessKey, sub-account without DNS permissions, domain under another account
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the provider API. Check that the Home Assistant host has outbound network access, or retry later
error.domain_required: Could not derive a domain from the Home Assistant URL, please enter the domain to bind the certificate to
error.invalid_record: That record name is not a valid hostname

abort.already_configured: This domain is already configured — its existing certificate is reused

init.title: Renewal and dynamic DNS
init.description:
Renewals start 30 days before expiry and restart Home Assistant afterwards.

**Certificate**: multiple names or a wildcard are supported; expiry and failures raise notifications and can post to a webhook.

**DDNS**: one 'name | type | value' per line; A / AAAA / CNAME / TXT in any number, auto follows this host's public address.

data.renew_days: Renew this many days before expiry

data_description.auto_renew: When off, renewal only happens via the issue button
data_description.renew_days: Renew when fewer days are left; 7–89
data_description.ddns_enabled: Compare the public address with the A/AAAA records on a schedule and rewrite them through the same DNS provider API
data_description.ddns_record: Empty means the certificate domain. Must exist in this provider account; missing records are created automatically
data_description.ddns_interval: How often to read the public IP and check the record, 5 minutes by default
data_description.ddns_record_types: Pick any of A (IPv4), AAAA (IPv6), CNAME (alias). AAAA needs a routable public IPv6 on this host
data_description.ddns_cname_record: Optional alias record, for example home. Leave empty to skip CNAME; must differ from the A/AAAA name
data_description.ddns_cname_target: Hostname the CNAME points to (for example another DDNS name); required when CNAME is selected
data_description.cert_domains: Comma separated; wildcard *.example.com is supported via DNS-01. Empty keeps the main domain only
data_description.expiry_alert_days: Notify once a day when fewer days remain than this value
data_description.notify_webhook: Optional. POST JSON on issuance failure or imminent expiry (chat bot webhooks work)
data_description.https_port: Port written next to the certificate; only applied when the HA HTTP store already has this key
data_description.tls_profile: Modern allows TLS 1.3 only; Intermediate also accepts TLS 1.2 for older devices
data_description.ddns_records: One per line: name | type | value. Types: A / AAAA / CNAME / TXT; use auto for the public address
data_description.ddns_ttl: TTL in seconds for created or updated records; providers may raise it to their minimum
data_description.ddns_notify: Send a persistent notification and fire ha_ssl_ddns_changed when a record changes

error.invalid_cname: CNAME needs both a record name and a valid target hostname
error.cname_conflict: The CNAME name cannot equal the A/AAAA name, DNS forbids CNAME next to other records
error.invalid_records: Fix the record list: one 'name | type | value' per line
error.invalid_webhook: Webhook must start with http:// or https://
error.invalid_domains: The certificate domain list contains an invalid name

renew.name: Issue / renew now
renew.description: Run one ACME dns-01 issuance immediately and write the certificate to the configured directory.

configure_https.name: Write HTTPS config and restart
configure_https.description: Write ssl_certificate / ssl_key into the HTTP config used by the running Home Assistant version (a pending store entry on 2026.11+, configuration.yaml with a backup on older versions), then restart so HTTPS takes effect.

restart.name: Restart automatically
restart.description: Restart Home Assistant right after the config is written.

promote_https.name: Confirm HTTPS config
promote_https.description: Promote the pending HTTPS config to the stable one and cancel the 5-minute auto-revert.

update_ddns.name: Update dynamic DNS now
update_ddns.description: Read the public IPv4 immediately, compare it with the A record and rewrite it when needed.
